item.title: Holy F*ck #2
item.description: Zeus, Isis, and the rest of Earth’s mythological gods have a destructive plan to regain humanity’s worship. Will it work? Not if Jesus, Satan, and a nun named Maria have anything to say about it! (That is, if Jesus and Satan can keep their hormones under control long enough to mount an attack.)Back-up Features:Holy Fck Origins: 994 ADHoly Fck Origins: 1958 ADRelease Dates:Digital Edition - 12/10/2014Print Edition - 03/04/2015
